name: Spacebring
positioning: Coworking software built for operators who run their space from a phone rather than a back office.
description: Spacebring is a coworking management platform combining billing, bookings, access and community into a single member web portal and white-label mobile app. It targets independent and small multi-location operators rather than large enterprise flex brands.
real_estate_use: A coworking operator uses Spacebring to sign up new members, run recurring billing automatically, let members book desks and rooms from a branded app, and manage day-to-day operations from a phone rather than a dedicated back-office team — useful for operators running one or a handful of locations with a lean staff.
features: Member web portal and white-label mobile app

use_cases.job: Run billing and bookings for an independent coworking space without a dedicated back-office team
